entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I want to return these absolutely worthless cycling shoes I bought. This is a joke!
I'm very sorry to hear you're unhappy with your purchase. To make sure I understand, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes?

What's the issue? I've ridden in them three times and they've given me massive blisters on both heels! On top of that, I could barely get the cleats to seat properly. They're junk and I want a full refund, now!

I can certainly understand your frustration; getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can absolutely look into processing a return for you. Can I get your order number, please?
Ugh, fine. It's VF449012. You'd better not give me some runaround about this.
Thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the cycling shoes, delivered 33 days ago. Let me just quickly confirm our return policy on this item.
Don't you dare tell me I'm outside some window! Your website says 90 days! I want to speak to a manager if you're going to deny this. I'll post a review on every single website you can imagine!
There's no need for that, sir, I can help you directly. You are absolutely correct. You are well within our 90-day return policy for this item. I'm approving this return for a full refund right now.
Oh. You're... you're just approving it? So I get my money back?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return, and an email with a pre-paid shipping label is on its way to you. Just package the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, your refund will be processed.
Huh. Okay. Well, that's what I wanted. Thank you.
You are very welcome. Again, I do apologize for the trouble with the shoes. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
